binding_note: 20 GiB is 0.020 TiB, and the 1M requests/month cap would bind even earlier for small datagrams. No non-HTTP transport exists.

reliability_note: Idle apps shut down after about 20-30 seconds and scale to zero.
confidence_note: The request meter is described as inbound HTTP; no page states a UDP or raw TCP listener, and none can be configured.

notes: Deploy Classic was shut down on 2026-07-20, before this read; the current Deno Deploy is the record. Outbound sockets existed for clients, never an inbound port.

extras.wg_detail: Inbound is HTTP requests only: the free tier meters "Allowed inbound HTTP requests to your deployments". There is no port to bind.
